text:
sasha: noticed flapping after failover — prefixes get evicted then immediately refetched. i think our handoff leaves nodes with inconsistent "recency". small proposal: add a ticket (node_id + counter) to residency records plus an access_epoch. eviction orders by (access_epoch, ticket) so transfers remain deterministic.

mike: ticket assignment: node-local counter + node id? any wrap concerns?

sasha: yes, node-local counter + node id. counter is 64-bit; on restart node emits a tombstone with last counter so others treat older counters as expired.

anna: how do you avoid stale tickets preventing eviction forever?

sasha: access_epoch bumped on access; eviction prefers higher epoch. ticket only tiebreaks. also add a short soft-pin on new transfers.

jordan: rehydrate and duplicate transient fills worry me.

sasha: background fills request a ticket from owner before becoming resident; otherwise remain transient and don't compete.

mike: race: eviction at source while transferring?

sasha: handshake: source marks TRANSFERRING+last_ticket, dest pulls and ACKs; source defers eviction until ACK or timeout.

anna: rollout plan?

sasha: 1) advertise fields but keep old comparator, 2) collect telemetry (post-handoff refetchs), 3) opt-in per-shard flag, 4) flip default.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: FYI kv-cache/evict-ticket-sim flaky in CI, investigate seed failures: https://ci.internal/12345

mike: ok. anna/jordan please review — if no showstoppers i'll write RFC + tests (comparator unit, tombstone recovery, chaos failover + rehydrate + evict).
